test_swaplevel_series: test the pandas Series.swaplevel method to swap two index levels on a MultiIndex Series
test_swaplevel_series_default: test the pandas Series.swaplevel method with default arguments swapping level 0 and 1
test_swaplevel_series_by_position: test the pandas Series.swaplevel method with integer level positions as arguments
test_swaplevel_series_by_label: test the pandas Series.swaplevel method with string level names as arguments
test_swaplevel_dataframe_axis: test the pandas DataFrame.swaplevel method with axis parameter on a transposed MultiIndex DataFrame
